name: Ciprefadol
summary: Ciprefadol is an opioid analgesic that is an isoquinoline derivative most closely related to cyclazocine and picenadol, with a number of other related compounds known. Ciprefadol is a mixed agonist–antagonist at μ-opioid receptors and can partly block the effects of morphine at low doses, though at higher doses it acts more like a full agonist.

pharmacology.text: Ciprefadol is a mixed agonist–antagonist at μ-opioid receptors and can partly block the effects of morphine at low doses, though at higher doses it acts more like a full agonist. It is also a potent κ-opioid agonist, unlike the corresponding N-methyl and N-phenethyl derivatives which are reasonably μ-selective agonists.

summaryZh: 環丙法朵是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C19H27NO，屬於十氫異喹啉衍生物，能用作類阿片鎮痛藥。

uses.en: It is not known to be in medical use and has mainly been of research interest.
uses.zh: 目前未知它有任何醫療用途，主要具研究價值。
uses.zhHans: 目前未知它有任何医疗用途，主要具研究价值。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Opioids that strongly activate kappa receptors can cause unease, confusion and hallucinations, alongside typical opioid effects such as drowsiness, nausea and slowed breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。強力活化 κ 受體的鴉片類藥物可能造成不安、意識混亂與幻覺，同時伴隨嗜睡、噁心與呼吸抑制等典型鴉片類作用。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。强力活化 κ 受体的鸦片类药物可能造成不安、意识混乱与幻觉，同时伴随嗜睡、恶心与呼吸抑制等典型鸦片类作用。

fact.en: Mixed agonist-antagonist opioids like it were developed in the hope of relieving pain with less risk of addiction and overdose. Many, however, caused unpleasant mental effects through the kappa opioid receptor.
fact.zh: 像它這樣的混合型促效拮抗鴉片類藥物，是為了在止痛的同時降低成癮與過量風險而研發的。然而其中許多藥物會透過 κ 鴉片類受體造成令人不適的精神作用。
fact.zhHans: 像它这样的混合型促效拮抗鸦片类药物，是为了在止痛的同时降低成瘾与过量风险而研发的。然而其中许多药物会通过 κ 鸦片类受体造成令人不适的精神作用。
